verdict.rationale: Relay is a hosted, regulated business-banking service: checking accounts, Visa cards, ACH and wires, and savings. Self-hosting the core product is a category error for a bank account service, since the banking itself cannot run on user infrastructure. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable component exists that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
